claim_verdicts.evidence: StatelessWidget docs: 'useful when the part of the user interface you are describing does not depend on anything other than the configuration information in the object itself and the [BuildContext] in which the widget is inflated.' and 'The [build] method of a stateless widget is typically only called in three situations: the first time the widget is inserted in the tree, when the widget's parent changes its configuration ..., and when an [InheritedWidget] it depends on changes.' So 'only when its parent rebuilds it with new inputs' omits the context case.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: A StatelessWidget builds only from its inputs and the context it is built in; it shows something different when its parent builds it again with new inputs, or when something it reads from its context changes.

claim_verdicts.evidence: ui/index.md: 'When this widget's parent rebuilds, the parent creates a new instance of `ShoppingList`, but the framework reuses the `_ShoppingListState` instance that is already in the tree rather than calling `createState` again.' framework.dart Widget doc: 'Widgets themselves have no mutable state (all their fields must be final).' The parent (its build), not Flutter, creates the new instance, and updateChild skips identical instances ('if (hasSameSuperclass && child.widget == newWidget)'), so 'every time' is too strong.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: Widgets are immutable; the parent's build normally creates new widget objects each time it runs. A StatefulWidget's State is created by createState when the widget is inserted, is reused while it stays in the tree, and has the build method.

claim_verdicts.evidence: git show stage-1:DonHang.App/lib/main.dart lines 12-24: 'class DonHangApp extends StatelessWidget', no declared fields, build returns MaterialApp(title: 'Đơn Hàng', theme: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo, ...), home: ProductListScreen(apiClient: apiClient)). But line 17 'final apiClient = ApiClient();' creates a new ApiClient on every build, so it is an equivalent, not the same, MaterialApp. Lesson wording ('describes the same app, with the same title, colours and first screen') is acceptable.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: DonHangApp extends StatelessWidget, declares no fields, and each build returns a MaterialApp with the same title, theme and first screen.
